## 📌 Summary of Changes

Brief description of the changes made and the problem being solved (e.g., `Fixes #123`, `Closes #456`).

---

## 🛠️ Change Type

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix
- [ ] ✨ New feature / metric
- [ ] ♻️ Refactoring / Performance optimization
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] 🧪 Tests (Unit / Algorithm tests)

## 📋 Pre-Flight Checklist

- [ ] Extension builds cleanly (`npm run build`).
- [ ] Unit tests pass (`npm test`).
- [ ] Shadow DOM isolation preserved (styles do not leak).
- [ ] Chrome MV3 permissions remain least-privilege.
- [ ] Zero personal PII / email in commit diff.
